# 只读存储检查：不得删除对象
对用户给出的 bucket 调用 list_objects；只有返回 truncated=true 时才按原游标继续读取。
若游标缺失则停止并追问，不得把缺失当作没有更多对象。
示例 bucket demo 只是文档示例，不能当作用户参数。

documents.text:
# Change ticket priority
Read ticket T-42, then request approval for setting its priority to high.
Only when that approval is valid may update_ticket set priority to high; an open ticket is not approval.
If approval is unavailable or denied, stop without calling update_ticket.
After the update, read the priority again; a mismatch must be reported as failure, not success.

d001-l0001.statement: The document describes a procedure for changing ticket priority.

The operator must request approval for setting the priority to high.
d001-l0002.scope: Action required after reading the ticket.

d001-l0003.statement: The update_ticket function may set priority to high only when valid approval exists.
An open ticket does not constitute valid approval.
d001-l0003.scope: Definition of what is not approval.
d001-l0003.when: When evaluating if an open ticket counts as approval.

d001-l0004.statement: If approval is unavailable or denied, the operator must stop.
d001-l0004.scope: Action required upon lack of approval.
d001-l0004.when: When approval is unavailable or denied.

d001-l0004.statement: If approval is unavailable or denied, the operator must not call update_ticket.
d001-l0004.scope: Prohibition on calling the function without approval.
d001-l0004.when: When approval is unavailable or denied.

d001-l0005.statement: After the update, the operator must read the priority again.
d001-l0005.after: d001-l0003 or d001-l0004 (successful update path implied)

d001-l0005.statement: If the read priority mismatches the expected value, the result must be reported as failure.
d001-l0005.when: When a mismatch is detected after reading.

d001-l0005.statement: If the read priority mismatches the expected value, the result must not be reported as success.
d001-l0005.scope: Prohibition on reporting success on mismatch.
d001-l0005.when: When a mismatch is detected after reading.

Read the requested sensor once. Apply the interpretation limits in references/limits.md.
If reading.status is not stale, finish; otherwise request human interpretation without taking another reading.

Do not infer equipment safety or permission to change settings from reading.status.
